question: Does the second Glushko scheduled window bound the transcript-indicated realized observation closely enough to serve as a content cohort without another registration layer?
terminal_objective: Compare one explicitly repeated plan window with content-led transcript anchors and the complete-action relationship manifest before any pixel access.
method: Replay Stage 11B, verify the source transcript bytes and four exact anchors, then count camera-3500015 complete actions by action-start time in half-open scheduled, transcript-envelope, overlap, post-transition, and explicit-diversion intervals. Treat the transcript envelope as a registration canary, not pixel ground truth.
authority: Private local metadata and transcript analysis only. No pixels, image-content label, target presence, complete realized-event boundary, model split, model performance, causal explanation, scientific result, novelty, or priority claim.

explicit_diversion_start.text: Alright, I'm just going to take a picture here.

explicit_diversion_end.text: We're still in the swap, so I still got some time here, but I'll just keep doing Glushko, and then I'll go on and use the rest of my time on something else.

claim_ceiling: Stage 11C may establish that, for the second Glushko repeat, the scheduled interval and a transcript-indicated activity envelope select materially different complete-action cohorts: 17 of 28 transcript-envelope actions precede the schedule, while 23 of 34 scheduled-window actions begin after the explicit spoken transition to Orientale. It may establish that the activity_id boundary follows the schedule rather than those spoken anchors and that the transcript envelope itself contains an explicit four-action diversion. It cannot identify what any image depicts, call the transcript envelope complete or single-target ground truth, label the post-transition pixels Orientale or the pre-window pixels Glushko, assign a valid model split, or make a performance, causal, scientific, novelty, or priority claim.

next_step_logic.if_paired_window_task_continues: Reconstruct realized segments from transcript anchors plus image-content registration, preserve diversions and target transitions, then freeze comparable camera-state strata before modeling.
next_step_logic.if_pixels_are_not_opened: Retain Glushko as a high-value candidate but downgrade plan windows and activity_id values from content cohorts to navigation priors.
next_step_logic.if_registration_cannot_separate_targets: Stop the paired-window task; do not repair it by trusting the schedule, activity_id, or blank target tags.
next_step_logic.if_registration_succeeds: Compare whole registered segments or task-shaped matched strata, and describe the evaluation as within-mission paired observation rather than new-event generalization or calibrated photometry.
next_step_logic.recheck_trigger: A pixel-level target registration, a camera-pose/geometry product, a revised activity annotation, or an independently curated realized-observation ledger.
